name: manual_950d45
claim: Git identity policy is canonical in orama-system (identity-policy.json + audit_engine.py); Perpetua-Tools must consume byte-identical copies via sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh — never maintain a third independent allowlist in PT scripts or repo_hygiene.

decisions.notes: PR #197/#209-#214 incident: partial updates across three hardcoded allowlists produced contradictory CI and spurious history-rewrite PRs. Integrated plan Phase 3 syncs guards to PT on a dedicated PR, separate from PR #276 TLS scope. Orama PR #217 landed Phases 1-2.
